decisive_items: well‐circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin, firm, gray‐white
response.rationale: The description of the lesion as firm and fibrotic with a well-circumscribed appearance is most consistent with a leiomyoma, although fibroma is also a possible diagnosis due to similar characteristics.

rejected.why: The firm consistency of the lesion contradicts the typical characteristics of a hemangioma.
